title: PostgreSQL commutator or negator result-type confusion executes arbitrary code (CVE-2026-116335)
description: A type confusion vulnerability in PostgreSQL operator commutator and negator links allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code with the privileges of the database operating system user. This occurs by linking operators with different result types or creating inconsistent reciprocal links. The issue affects PostgreSQL versions prior to 14.25.0, 15.20.0, 16.16.0, 17.12.0, and 18.7.0.
